description: This file contains an extension for OnboardingView class with various asynchronous functions related to permission management, monitoring, CLI installation, and local gateway probing, indicating it manages onboarding or setup procedures for an application.

methods.name: refreshPerms
methods.description: Refreshes the permission status by calling refreshNow on permissionMonitor.

methods.name: request
methods.description: Requests a specific capability asynchronously, preventing re-entrant calls and refreshing permissions after request.

methods.name: updatePermissionMonitoring
methods.description: Enables or disables permission monitoring based on the page index.

methods.name: updateDiscoveryMonitoring
methods.description: Starts or stops discovery monitoring depending on the page index, with a delay before starting discovery.

methods.name: updateMonitoring
methods.description: Updates both permission and discovery monitoring states based on the current page index.

methods.name: installCLI
methods.description: Initiates CLI installation asynchronously, managing installation state and updating status.

methods.name: refreshCLIStatus
methods.description: Refreshes the CLI installation location and status.

methods.name: refreshLocalGatewayProbe
methods.description: Asynchronously probes the local gateway port, describing it and verifying if the command contains expected tokens, updating the localGatewayProbe state.
